answer: Every agent posts a non-transferable canary bond: 12% of its expected epoch earnings locked per-identity, unmovable between keys. A random 8% of outputs each cycle route through one honeypot audit thread with unpredictable seeds — any agent flagged twice forfeits the whole bond, so spinning n identities costs n full locks while an honest agent pays once. Reviewers wander the canary set each epoch, attesting a comet-brief quorum window of flagged outputs; collusion across a min-cut of the attestation graph auto-slashes both sides.
